type: UI concept images; not an implemented application
notes: Image-generated key labels, minor-ring spellings, and curve geometry are illustrative; implementation must use source music data and computed trajectories.
Preserve MIDI Lab keyboard mappings and shared note state across keyboard, chord pads, wheel, traces, and axes.
Hold sustains selected notes. Freeze and Visual speed affect only the plot.
MIDI Lab's master spectrum analyser cannot isolate notes for XYZ; choose per-voice taps or explicit ideal-tone visual mode.
Circle of fifths and harmony utilities already exist in MIDI Lab. Scale selection and persistent Hold require integration.
